selection: First 76 numeric VM identifiers with a common complete five-minute calendar day; earliest eligible day; selection by identifier/time completeness only, never prediction results or CPU load
models: Frozen trend10/adaptive-memory20 and mean20 selector, prior-error min10; compare persistence, OLS, half trend and simple mean/median/EMA controls without tuning
scope: Forecast-only independent-provider test; normalize CPU percent to relative VM capacity and controlled equal-capacity four-VM host groups; do not reproduce provider VM sizes or claim energy savings
reserved: Do not inspect remaining VM outcomes or later days for model tuning in this stage
